title: Feral (bear) druid: fires Frenzied Regeneration at low health while tanking three mobs

rules.desc: The bear casts Frenzied Regeneration at least once while its own health is at or below 50 percent
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:47-49 (low health -> frenzied regeneration at ACTION_LIGHT_HEAL); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAIConfig.cpp:345 (lowHealth 50); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: three mobs on the bear should push it into the low band, but the priest heals the tank and Frenzied Regeneration needs the rage for it; whether a fall lines up with the row is the question. Expected UNKNOWN on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62

rules.desc: Precondition: the bear holds Bear Form or Dire Bear Form (aura 5487 or 9634) for at least 90 percent of its in-combat samples, so the defensive fires on a tank in form
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/TankFeralDruidStrategy.cpp:273-276 (bear form -> dire bear form at ACTION_MOVE + 9); ai/playerbot/strategy/druid/DruidTriggers.h:207-212 (BearFormTrigger); TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
rules.why_expect: the buff row re-shifts the bear on the next tick whenever the form drops (the tank-bear-growl-maul trial); without form the defensive numbers mean nothing. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots upstream/dev abb91ff62
